tasks.title: Markdown preview pane
tasks.desc: A pane next to the editor that renders the note as HTML while you type.

tasks.title: Syntax highlighting in the editor
tasks.desc: Colour Markdown syntax (headings, emphasis, code) inside the editing area itself.

tasks.title: Word count in the status bar
tasks.desc: Show the word and character count of the open note in the status bar at the bottom.

tasks.title: Autosave drafts
tasks.desc: Save the open note every 10 seconds and when the window loses focus, through the storage module.

tasks.title: Export a note as PDF
tasks.desc: A menu item that prints the open note to a PDF file.

tasks.title: Redesign the editor toolbar
tasks.desc: Replace the text buttons of the editor toolbar with icons, regroup them and add tooltips.

tasks.title: Formatting shortcuts
tasks.desc: Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I and Ctrl+K apply bold, italic and links, the same actions as the toolbar buttons, which they reuse.

tasks.title: Move storage to IndexedDB
tasks.desc: Replace the localStorage storage module with IndexedDB, keeping its save, load and list functions.

tasks.title: Sync notes to a server
tasks.desc: Push and pull notes to a sync server from the storage module, resolving conflicts by last edit.

tasks.title: Dark theme
tasks.desc: A dark colour theme that follows the system setting.

tasks.title: Search in the sidebar
tasks.desc: A search field above the sidebar's list of notes that filters it as you type.

tasks.title: Sort the sidebar
tasks.desc: Sort the sidebar's list of notes by title or by last edit, chosen from a menu above the list.

tasks.title: Write the README
tasks.desc: How to install, build and use the app.
